UI_KnoxLink_OptPanelKey_tip: Shows the address, PIN and QR code for your second screen.
UI_KnoxLink_OptImmersion: Immersion: only what your character knows
UI_KnoxLink_OptImmersion_tip: On: the time needs a watch (date and temperature need a digital one), the map follows the in-game map rules and shows only explored areas, and needs show as moodles instead of numbers. Off: everything, like a debug screen.
UI_KnoxLink_OptLan: Allow phones and tablets on your Wi-Fi
UI_KnoxLink_OptLan_tip: Off: only this device can connect (a dual-screen handheld or a browser on this PC). On: other devices on your network can connect with the PIN.
UI_KnoxLink_OptArrow_tip: Shows an arrow around your character pointing at the waypoint you set on the second screen.
UI_KnoxLink_OptHint: Connection hint when a game starts
UI_KnoxLink_OptHint_tip: A short note with the address, shown until a screen connects.
UI_KnoxLink_NoServer1: The Knox Link Server add-on is not running.
UI_KnoxLink_NoServer2: Enable "Knox Link Server" in the mod list.
UI_KnoxLink_NoServer3: It needs the ZombieBuddy framework installed.
UI_KnoxLink_NoServer4: See the mod page for a 2-minute guide.
UI_KnoxLink_Help1: Open the address in a browser on your phone, tablet,
UI_KnoxLink_Help2: second monitor or dual-screen handheld - same Wi-Fi.
UI_KnoxLink_HintTitle: Knox Link: open %1 on your second screen
UI_KnoxLink_HintSub: Press %1 for a QR code and more options.
UI_KnoxLink_OptKeyView_tip: In Project Viewpoint's 3D view: switches between first and third person. On a handheld, map a spare button to this key.
UI_KnoxLink_OptKeyBandage_tip: Bandages the wound that needs it most with your best bandage, like Knox Link's Bandage button.
UI_KnoxLink_OptKeyEat_tip: Eats what goes off first, only as much as you need.
UI_KnoxLink_OptKeyDrink_tip: Drinks clean water first, only as much as you need.
UI_KnoxLink_OptKeyLight_tip: Turns your flashlight or lantern on or off, taking it out of your bag if needed.
UI_KnoxLink_OptKeyWeapon_tip: Takes your best melee weapon in hand.
UI_KnoxLink_OptKeyPhoto_tip: Takes a photo of what's on the screen for today's journal page (with immersion on, you need a camera).
